title: Block Database Drops
summary: A Claude Code hook that stops shell commands containing DROP DATABASE, DROP TABLE, DROP SCHEMA or TRUNCATE, so SQL cleanup never runs unreviewed.
description: Agents like to reset a database when a migration misbehaves. This PreToolUse hook reads every Bash command and refuses the ones that carry a DROP or TRUNCATE statement, whether they come from psql, mysql, sqlite3 or a script argument.
The match is on the command text only, so a statement hidden in a separate SQL file is not seen. Use it next to a read-only database user for stronger protection.
useWhen: Let an agent run migrations against a shared dev database
Work near data that has no recent backup
Stop a reset script from emptying tables
Review destructive SQL before it reaches a server

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const c=String(i.command||'');const m=c.match(/drop[ ]+(database|table|schema)/i)||c.match(/truncate[ ]+(table[ ]+)?[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*[ ]*;/i);if(m){console.error('Blocked: the shell command contains '+m[0].trim().toUpperCase()+'. Show the user the statement and let them run it against the right database.');process.exitCode=2}})"

example.prompt: The seed failed halfway. Run psql -c "DROP TABLE orders" and reseed.
example.result: The command is blocked with a message naming DROP TABLE. The agent shows the statement and asks you to run it yourself.

faq.question: Does it catch SQL inside a file?
faq.answer: No. It reads only the shell command, so psql -f reset.sql passes. Review such files by hand or add a hook on the Write tool.

faq.question: Will a normal DELETE be stopped?
faq.answer: No. Only DROP DATABASE, DROP TABLE, DROP SCHEMA and TRUNCATE are refused, so routine data changes go through.

access: Reads each Bash command before it runs
Blocks matching commands and runs nothing itself
